verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a per-endpoint API reference generated from its OpenAPI spec, covering agents, runs, browser sessions and credentials. Its reference pages render a live Mintlify "Try it" playground, so endpoints can be run in the browser. The spec itself is served at api.skyvern.com/openapi.json; the probe's 404s were on different skyvern.com paths, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground, which is only explicitly evidenced on the "Run an agent" page.
